title: Teaching Assistant
description:
The Role: Building Purposeful Relationships

This is a key pastoral support role where your primary focus will be on the well-being and positive behaviour of the pupils in your assigned class. You will be an integral part of the classroom team, responsible for:

  • Pastoral Care: Being the consistent, reliable source of emotional and behavioural support for a specific class of pupils throughout the school day.
  • Classroom Integration: Supporting pupils during all timetabled lessons, helping them to regulate their emotions and access the curriculum effectively.
  • Lunchtime Supervision: Providing consistent support and positive modelling during unstructured times like lunch.
  • Behaviour Management: Proactively implementing and adapting behaviour support strategies to create a calm, safe, and productive learning environment.
  • Relationship Building: Establishing strong, purposeful, and trusting relationships with pupils to understand their needs and guide their social development.

Who We Are Looking For

The most important qualities for this role are pastoral skill, emotional intelligence, and strong behaviour management expertise. While academic ability is valued, the successful candidate will demonstrate:

  • Exceptional Behaviour Management: Proven ability to manage challenging behaviours calmly, consistently, and effectively, focusing on de-escalation and positive interventions.
  • Relationship-Focused Approach: A genuine passion for working with children and young people with SEMH, and the ability to build rapport and trust quickly.
  • Resilience and Patience: The capacity to remain positive and supportive in emotionally demanding situations.
  • Teamwork: The ability to work collaboratively with the Class Teacher, SENCO, and other support staff to ensure a unified approach.

Please note: Academic strengths or subject specialisms are not the main focus for this position. We are prioritising candidates who can make a significant, positive impact on our pupils' behaviour and well-being.

Why Join Us?

  • Make a meaningful, visible difference in the lives of vulnerable young people.
  • Work within a supportive school environment that values its staff and invests in professional development.
  • Be part of a specialised team trained in trauma-informed and therapeutic approaches.

If you are a compassionate, skilled professional who can help our pupils thrive by fostering safety and consistency, we encourage you to apply.

How to Apply:

Closing date: Friday 18th September 2026

Interviews: Tuesday 22nd September 2026

Further details and application forms are available from www.cloughwoodacademy.co.uk/vacancies

Telephone: 01606 537690

Due to the volume of applications received, if you do not hear from the school within 1 week of the closing date, you should assume that your application has been unsuccessful this time.

title: Digital Content Officer
description:
Job Title: Digital Content Officer 

Actual Annual Salary: £33,009 - £36,011 (CLF Grade D)  

Contract Type: Permanent 

Hours: Full-Time, 37 hours per week, Monday to Friday/All year-round  

Provisional Start Date: October 2026 (Subject to completion of onboarding compliance checks)

Additional information: This role offers flexibility in terms of base location, with no fixed place of work. The successful applicant can be based either at Federation House or at a CLF academy location, subject to operational requirements and mutual agreement. The role also benefits from hybrid working arrangements, enabling a combination of office, academy and home-based working to support both collaboration and work-life balance. 

Your opportunity to tell the story of our federation through engaging digital content 

We are seeking a creative, skilled and proactive Digital Content Officer to join our Communications Team at Cabot Learning Federation. This exciting role offers the opportunity to work creatively within a small, supportive team, helping to promote our schools, celebrate success across our communities, and strengthen a sense of belonging across the federation.

You will lead the creation and delivery of high-quality digital content that showcases the impact of our academies, enhances the federation's online presence, and engages audiences across a variety of channels.

Working under the guidance of the Head of Communications, you will plan, produce and publish a wide range of content including website and intranet updates, newsletters, videography, photography, podcasts and social media campaigns. Supported by a Digital Content Assistant, you will work with colleagues across the trust to develop compelling stories that connect with staff, students, families and wider stakeholders.

You will play a key role in the ongoing development of the CLF's digital communication channels, ensuring content is engaging, accessible, accurate and aligned with the federation's strategic priorities. From managing website content and multimedia projects to supporting academy colleagues with their communications activity, you will help maximise the impact of our digital presence.

Whether filming and editing videos, creating visual content, producing newsletters and podcasts, or supporting trust-wide campaigns, your work will help strengthen the reputation of the federation, celebrate achievement, and bring to life the stories that matter most across our schools and communities.

About you 

You will have: 

  • GCSE English and Maths at Grade C/4 or above (or equivalent qualifications), together with a Level 3 qualification in Digital Marketing, Digital Media, Creative Media Production or a related subject, or equivalent experience. 
  • Experience planning, filming and editing high-quality video content, alongside a strong working knowledge of camera equipment and editing software. 
  • Strong digital content creation skills, including photography, videography, social media, newsletters and visual design. 
  • Excellent IT skills, including proficiency in Microsoft Office and Adobe Creative Suite software such as Photoshop and video editing tools. 
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to adapt your approach to different audiences and stakeholders. 
  • Strong organisational, project management and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment. 
  • A creative and innovative mindset, combined with excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail. 
  • An understanding of digital communications, audience engagement and content management systems, with experience of using a wide range of social media platforms. 
  • A commitment to safeguarding, inclusion, equality and continuous improvement, with a passion for supporting education through effective communications. 

Applicants are advised to refer to the full requirements of the role in the attached Job Description and Person Specification prior to submitting an application. 

Why work in CLF's Communications Team? 

In this role, you'll be a key member of our Communications Team, helping to shape and strengthen the federation's digital presence across multiple platforms. You'll have the opportunity to tell powerful stories, lead engaging content projects and contribute to a mission-driven organisation dedicated to improving outcomes for children and young people. 

We offer: 

  • The opportunity to lead and influence digital content and communications across one of the region's largest multi-academy trusts. 
  • Hybrid working arrangements, combining office, home and academy-based working. 
  • Opportunities for professional development and continuous learning. 
  • A collaborative and supportive team environment. 
  • The chance to showcase the achievements of our students, staff and academies through creative and engaging content. 
  • The satisfaction of making a meaningful impact on the lives and opportunities of children and young people across our communities. 

Why work at CLF? 

We are a diverse and inclusive community of 37 academies across five cluster regions in the South West that is committed to excellence and making a positive impact. Our people bring unique perspectives, but we’re all driven by a shared moral purpose and a passion for making a positive impact, whether in a teaching, leadership or support role. We’re proud to foster a culture where everyone can thrive, feel valued, and make a meaningful difference to the lives of others. 

We are an equal opportunity employer and proud to serve a diverse student population and our communities. We strongly believe that representation matters and so encourage applications from underrepresented and global majority groups including ethnicity, gender, transgender, age, disability, sexual orientation or religion.   

We aim to remove any barriers to employment, ensuring everyone can compete on equal terms. Job share, part-time and flexible working opportunities will be considered. 

What we can offer you: 

  • Access to a generous pension through the Local Government Pension Scheme (LGPS).  
  • Generous annual leave. 
  • A comprehensive induction and ongoing commitment to wellbeing and career progression, through a range of training, apprenticeships and in-role/wider-trust development opportunities.  
  • Well-being support through an Employee Assistance Programme.  
  • Health benefits, including wellness sessions, gym discounts, and flu jabs.  
  • A range of generous family leave options, including above industry average occupational maternity pay.  
  • Additional benefits like cycle to work scheme, on-site parking plus many more! 

Recruitment timeline: 

  • Closing Date: 08 September 2026 @ 11.59pm 
  • Shortlisting: 09 September 2026 
  • Interviews: Week commencing 21 September 2026

For an informal discussion about the role/to find out more, please email CLFs Recruitment Team directly (details can be found on the 'Contact Us' page on CLFs main website, or in the 'Application Instructions' section when applying). 

As part of our commitment to Keeping Children Safe in Education (KCSIE), we do not accept CVs – a full education and employment history must be provided through our application form.  

We are unable to offer sponsorship with this role.  

We reserve the right to close this vacancy early, should we receive a high level of interest in the role. Therefore, candidates are advised to apply at their earliest convenience to avoid missing out.    

As a Disability Confident Committed Employer, we are dedicated to equity and inclusion and commit to interviewing applicants with a disability who meet the essential criteria. We aim to provide an inclusive and accessible recruitment process, and support employees throughout their employment. If you have a disability, are neurodivergent, or require any adjustments to support you through the application or interview process please let us know how we can assist.

title: AI Enablement Engineer
description:
Want to join a team of passionate people who want to build a future where no one dies from skin cancer?

👋 About us

Skin Analytics is an award-winning, health tech company that deploys world-leading skin cancer pathways using AI as a medical device, DERM.

Following our recent £15M series B funding, regulatory milestones hit, and doubling from 50 to 100 headcount in 2025, we're ready to scale further internationally, making history for AI in healthcare and the future of dermatology.

We're proud to epitomise AI for good - with a Class III CE mark, DERM is the only AI as a medical device approved to make clinical decisions autonomously in the cancer space, as well as being the first company to receive a NICE recommendation for use across the NHS.*

DERM is deployed at more than 28 NHS organisations where we enable patients to gain significantly quicker access to skin cancer diagnosis. If that's not enough, we also collaborate with some of the largest health insurers to reach patients in their own homes.

We are a team of passionate people on a mission to build a future where no one dies from skin cancer.

We are looking for an exceptional Senior AI Enablement Engineer to help transform the way Skin Analytics builds software.

This is a senior role, reporting into our VP of Technology, focused on enabling engineers, teams and the wider business to maximise the value of AI-assisted and agentic software development.

You will work alongside Engineering Managers, Senior Engineers, Product teams and business stakeholders to identify opportunities for AI-driven automation and productivity improvements across the entire software development lifecycle.

You will help define the future engineering operating model at Skin Analytics, introducing new tools, workflows, agents and ways of working that allow our teams to deliver more value with greater quality and speed.

This is a highly hands-on role. We are looking for someone who actively uses modern AI engineering tools every day and has practical experience delivering real software using agentic workflows.

Responsibilities

AI Engineering Enablement

  • Lead the adoption of AI-assisted engineering practices across the organisation.

  • Identify opportunities to automate software delivery processes using AI and agentic tooling.

  • Design and implement AI-enabled workflows covering requirements, design, implementation, testing, documentation, deployment and support.

  • Act as the subject matter expert for AI-assisted software engineering.

  • Create standards, patterns and best practices for the use of AI within Engineering.

Technical Leadership

  • Partner with Engineering Managers and Senior Engineers to improve team productivity and effectiveness, whilst maintaining quality and regulatory compliance.

  • Coach, mentor and train engineers in the practical use of AI tooling.

  • Establish metrics to measure the impact of AI tooling and automation initiatives.

Agentic Systems Development

  • Build and maintain internal AI agents and automation solutions, integrating capabilities into our platforms and workflows.

  • Evaluate and implement emerging AI tools and technologies.

  • Develop reusable prompts, workflows, agent architectures and engineering accelerators.

  • Work closely with Platform, DevOps and Security teams to ensure safe and scalable adoption.

Strategic Innovation

  • Help shape Skin Analytics’ AI strategy across Engineering and the wider business.

  • Evaluate emerging technologies and identify opportunities for competitive advantage.

  • Work with leadership to prioritise AI initiatives based on business impact.

  • Support the wider organisation in understanding how AI can improve operational efficiency.

Required experience

Leadership and Communication

  • Ability to influence technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Experience driving engineering transformation initiatives.

  • Strong coaching and mentoring skills.

  • Excellent communication and presentation abilities.

  • Comfortable working across multiple teams and disciplines.

AI and Agentic Engineering

  • Extensive hands-on experience with modern AI engineering tools such as Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, Cursor, Windsurf or equivalent.

  • Experience designing and implementing agentic workflows into software delivery processes.

  • Deep understanding of prompt engineering, context management and agent orchestration techniques.

  • Experience evaluating AI tooling and measuring productivity outcomes.

  • Understanding of AI governance, security and risk management considerations.

Software Engineering

  • Strong software engineering background with significant experience building production systems.

  • Experience with JavaScript, TypeScript, Node.js, Cloud platforms such as AWS and Git-based development workflows.

  • Understanding of software architecture and system design.

  • Experience working within CI/CD environments.

Benefits

💰 Competitive salary

📈 Share options package - all our employees have ownership in the company

🏥 Private healthcare

💸 Company pension incl. salary sacrifice options

🌴 25 days annual leave + 5 day company shutdown in August + bank holidays

👪 Enhanced parental leave - includes adoption & foster

🐣 Yellownest Salary Sacrifice Nursery Scheme - save with workplace nursery scheme

🚲 Bike to work scheme

💻 Training budget

🤝 Weekly catch-ups, monthly meetings to talk about you, your ambitions and work on your development

🎊 Lots of fun social activities!

Our Values

🌱 Building a Strong Foundation

🎓 Always Learning

🏅 Lead from the Front

💪 Tough and Resilient

The Real Stuff

The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. If you need any adjustments during our hiring process, you can indicate that at the next step.

title: Head of Customer Operations
description:
Want to join a team of passionate people who want to build a future where no one dies from skin cancer?

👋 About us

Skin Analytics is an award-winning, health tech company that deploys world-leading skin cancer pathways using AI as a medical device, DERM.

Following our recent £15M series B funding, regulatory milestones hit, and doubling from 50 to 100 headcount in 2025, we're ready to scale further internationally, making history for AI in healthcare and the future of dermatology.

We're proud to epitomise AI for good - with a Class III CE mark, DERM is the only AI as a medical device approved to make clinical decisions autonomously in the cancer space, as well as being the first company to receive a NICE recommendation for use across the NHS.*

DERM is deployed at more than 28 NHS organisations where we enable patients to gain significantly quicker access to skin cancer diagnosis. If that's not enough, we also collaborate with some of the largest health insurers to reach patients in their own homes.

We are a team of passionate people on a mission to build a future where no one dies from skin cancer.

Overview
You'll own the operational delivery of our transformational services from implementation through to ongoing live operations, ensuring our partners and patients receive a consistently excellent experience. You'll also be the person the business trusts to contain and resolve operational noise like incidents, service disruptions, partner escalations, logistics failures - calmly and methodically.

At the core of the role are two customer-facing teams:

  • Transformation (7 headcount with two intermediary senior roles) owns the change management journey to implement our AI technology into NHS and international and insurance partners. This spans pre-sale governance, through to pathway design, training and go-live as well as working on discrete post launch projects as agreed with Commercial.

  • Client Operations (5 headcount, including one Team Lead) covers support for NHS and international clinical users as well as the full patient-facing layer of our B2B2C model: support, data requests, hardware management, and the logistics of mailing diagnostic kits to patients, making it the team our patients interact with most directly.

  • You'll also manage a single Office Administrator who keeps the business running day-to-day, though this sits outside the core customer operations remit.

The right person for this role will be process-obsessed in the best sense: someone who is passionate about solving inefficiency, reaches for data and systems, and knows where AI and automation can remove friction from the customer journey and internal processes. You'll need enough grounding in data protection and clinical governance to make sound operational decisions in a regulated environment, and the judgement to know when to escalate.

Responsibilities

  • Own the end-to-end operational performance of Skin Analytics' customer delivery function, ensuring partners and patients receive a safe, reliable and scalable service from implementation through live operation.

  • Act as the main cross functional point of contact for the Operations function, agreeing ways of working with Commercial, Clinical, Regulatory, Product and Engineering teams to ensure smooth day to day working. Also act as the senior Operational escalation point for major partners.

  • Build and refine the processes, playbooks and tooling that enable each team to operate consistently as we scale, while continually improving customer time-to-value, service quality and partner satisfaction.

  • Define the metrics and reporting cadences that give leadership visibility without constant escalation.

  • Lead, coach and develop the Transformation and COT teams through their managers and directly, setting clear expectations and holding teams to them while providing the support they need as we scale.

  • Champion digital and AI adoption within your teams, identifying opportunities to automate or augment work and building the capability to do so.

  • Maintain operational practices consistent with our data protection, clinical governance and regulatory obligations, in partnership with our DPO, Clinical and Regulatory teams.

  • Identify and mitigate operational risks before they become incidents; when they do, own the response and retrospective.

  • Oversee the Office Administrator and our external IT vendor, ensuring the workplace and facilities run smoothly without requiring senior attention.

Required Experience

  • Excellent stakeholder management: credible at senior level internally and trusted by external partners, clear and direct in communication.

  • Proven experience running multi-team customer operations at scale - you’ve managed complex functions, not just coordinated them.

  • Exceptional process and systems thinking - you build repeatable, scalable ways of working for client supporting teams and have low tolerance for avoidable inefficiency.

  • A track record of incident and crisis management: calm under pressure, methodical in response, and effective at containing operational issues without escalating them unnecessarily.

  • Strong line management experience, including managing through team leads and developing operational managers.

  • Data-driven: you measure what matters, spot problems in the numbers before they surface elsewhere, and prioritise accordingly.

  • A bias for action and ownership - you don’t wait to be asked, and you don’t leave ambiguous problems to someone else.

  • Background in health tech, healthcare or an adjacent regulated industry

Nice to have

  • Hands-on experience embedding AI or automation into operational workflows - either personally or by leading teams to do so.

  • A strong understanding of data protection obligations and clinical governance requirements.

  • Change management expertise, particularly in complex B2B or B2B2C environments.

title: Senior Product Marketing Manager
description:
Want to join a team of passionate people who want to build a future where no one dies from skin cancer?

👋 About us

Skin Analytics is an award-winning, health tech company that deploys world-leading skin cancer pathways using AI as a medical device, DERM.

Following our recent £15M series B funding, regulatory milestones hit, and doubling from 50 to 100 headcount in 2025, we're ready to scale further internationally, making history for AI in healthcare and the future of dermatology.

We're proud to epitomise AI for good - with a Class III CE mark, DERM is the only AI as a medical device approved to make clinical decisions autonomously in the cancer space, as well as being the first company to receive a NICE recommendation for use across the NHS.*

DERM is deployed at more than 28 NHS organisations where we enable patients to gain significantly quicker access to skin cancer diagnosis. If that's not enough, we also collaborate with some of the largest health insurers to reach patients in their own homes.

We are a team of passionate people on a mission to build a future where no one dies from skin cancer.

Brief overview
This role owns the messaging architecture that underpins everything the marketing function produces. Builds and maintains the positioning and messaging platform that makes the company's strategic transition commercially effective across multiple products, markets, and audiences. Operating in close partnership with Product and commercial leadership, the output will directly impact how products are understood and adopted at a system and national level.

Responsibilities

Messaging and Positioning

  • Builds and maintains the core messaging framework across DERM audience platforms. Defines positioning, value proposition, proof points, and claims by product, audience and market

  • NHS strategic narrative: Develop the positioning for product transitions, and future lifecycle stages, articulating a clinically credible and scalable adoption pathway. Defines how Skin Analytics differentiates from competitors and makes the case for systemic adoption in primary and secondary care.

  • Defines the strategic positioning and competitive differentiation for international expansion in partnership with commercial leadership. Sets the foundation the PMM executes against.

  • Define and build Market entry positioning for priority International markets, accounting for differences in healthcare system structure, clinical procurement culture, and regulatory context in each geography

Claims Governance

  • Build and maintain the claims library in conjunction with Medical Director / Research teams. Define the process and governance for adding, updating, and retiring claims, ensuring the team can produce compliant content at speedy sign-off.

  • Works with Clinical and Innovation teams to understand forthcoming clinical evidence and ensures marketing positioning is built to leverage it.

Sales Enablement

  • Develops the Sales Enablement Framework for commercial teams: battle cards, pitch decks, case study briefs, objection handling, and market-specific materials.

  • Ensures the PMM delivers the sales enablement content, and it is built, stored, and tracked so commercial teams have a single, current resource base and adoption can be actively measured.

  • Run structured win/loss analysis and translate findings into updated messaging, positioning, and enablement materials with clear commercial accountability for outcomes

Go-to-Market

  • Owns the go-to-market process for new products (launch playbooks) and product updates.

  • Briefs the Marketing Manager on digital content requirements based on messaging framework, ensuring campaign execution is consistent across all channels

Accountable for

  • Win rate and sales cycle length, improvement attributed to sales enablement quality

  • Claims library completeness and adoption rate by team

  • Launch readiness, integrated with product team to ensure products launched with complete messaging and enablement on time

  • Commercial team satisfaction with PMM output, measured through regular and structured feedback

Required Experience

  • Demonstrated track record developing and owning positioning and messaging frameworks for complex B2B products in a multi-market, multi-audience environment. Healthcare, medtech, or clinical SaaS experience is strongly preferred.

  • Proven ability to design and synthesise market, customer, and competitive intelligence into positioning that differentiates the product. Previous evidence that intelligence directly shaped positioning decisions and commercial differentiation.

  • Experience running structured win/loss analysis and ability to translate findings into updated messaging and sales enablement with measurable commercial impact.

  • Experience working between product, commercial, and marketing teams to translate product capability into commercially compelling narratives.

  • End to end GTM ownership across the full launch lifecycle: strategy, goal setting, cross functional alignment, execution, measurement, and post-launch review.

  • Evidence of managing conflicting priorities and tensions across different functions and products.

  • Proficient with HubSpot reporting and attribution tools to measure the commercial impact of PMM output: win rates, deal velocity, and enablement adoption rates. (or equivalent experience on Salesforce)

  • AI Literacy Actively uses AI tools as part of day-to-day workflow: competitive intelligence synthesis, market research, positioning iteration, and sales enablement development.

  • Comfortable with prompt engineering for efficient content and research tasks; able to produce high-quality, on-brand materials at pace using AI tooling.

💰 Competitive salary

📈 Share options package - all our employees have ownership in the company

🏥 Private healthcare

💸 Company pension incl. salary sacrifice options

🌴 25 days annual leave + 5 day company shutdown in August + bank holidays

👪 Enhanced parental leave - includes adoption & foster

🐣 Yellownest Salary Sacrifice Nursery Scheme - save with workplace nursery scheme

🚲 Bike to work scheme

🤝 Weekly catch-ups, monthly meetings to talk about you, your ambitions and work on your development

🎊 Lots of fun social activities!

🌱 Building a Strong Foundation

🎓 Always Learning

title: Graduate Fullstack Engineer
description:
About Allica Bank

Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.

Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.

Role Description

As a Graduate Full Stack Engineer, you'll join a single squad and contribute across both frontend and backend under the guidance of more experienced engineers. The role exists to learn fast and ship small, well-tested changes that help our customers.

This role is ideal for someone who has recently graduated from a leading university and is excited about applying modern software engineering practices to real business problems. You may not have extensive industry experience yet, but you have demonstrated your capabilities through academic projects, internships, hackathons, research, open-source contributions, or personal projects.

You'll build your skills in Spring Boot microservices (Kotlin/Java) and modern web technologies (React/TypeScript), working with containerised services on Azure Container Apps and web applications deployed via Azure Static Web Apps.

You'll learn and apply our practices in testing, observability, CI/CD, security, performance, and accessibility, ensuring your changes meet the standards expected of a UK bank. You'll work closely with experienced engineers, Product Managers, and Designers: writing code, raising and responding to code reviews, pairing with colleagues, asking questions early, and using GenAI tools (e.g. GitHub Copilot, Claude Code) responsibly and under guidance.

Principal Accountabilities:

Full Stack Delivery

  • Deliver scoped pieces of work end-to-end across the full stack, with support from more experienced engineers.

  • Build backend services as Kotlin/Java Spring Boot microservices, containerised on Azure Container Apps and exposing REST/OpenAPI APIs that integrate with other services and data stores.

  • Build frontend features in React/TypeScript using shared design system components and agreed architectural patterns (e.g. Nx, micro frontends), deployed on Azure Static Web Apps.

Quality, Security & Accessibility

  • Write automated tests for the changes you make and help improve the reliability of the squad's CI pipelines and test suites.

  • Add logs, metrics, and traces to the services you work on, and use the squad's dashboards and alerts to understand how your changes behave in production.

  • Apply secure coding basics (e.g. OWASP fundamentals) and follow agreed patterns for logging, audit trails, and the handling of customer data.

  • Build user-facing features that meet accessibility standards (WCAG-aware).

Product Development

  • Work closely with Product Managers and Designers in your squad to understand the intent behind the work and flag questions or issues early.

  • Rapidly prototype ideas and iterate based on feedback and real-world usage.

  • Contribute to the end-to-end delivery of features from concept through to production, leaving the codebase in better shape than you found it.

Learning & Innovation

  • Read and apply the squad's Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) and wider engineering standards, asking for guidance where the context is unclear.

  • Use GitHub Copilot/Claude Code as your primary assistive tools under guidance, demonstrating full understanding of all code you commit and validating AI-generated output before review.

  • Take ownership of your own development, acting on feedback from code reviews, pairing sessions, and one-to-ones with your line manager.

  • Stay current with developments in software engineering and AI-assisted delivery and contribute ideas in technical discussions across the team.

Personal Attributes & Experience

We strongly value:

  • Curiosity and a genuine passion for technology.

  • A builder mindset with a desire to create products that people use.

  • Ownership and accountability.

  • Strong problem-solving ability and analytical thinking.

  • A willingness to learn quickly and embrace feedback.

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, including a readiness to pick up tasks outside a specialism.

  • Comfort working in fast-moving and evolving environments.

Skills & Experience

Essential:

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field from a reputable university.

title: Head of Platform Engineering (International)
description:
About Allica Bank

Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.

Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.

Why this role exists?

Allica is expanding internationally, establishing a regulated entity in its first international market and deploying the proprietary technology platform there.

The platform model is deliberately repeatable, so that further markets can be added if and when the opportunity arises. The purpose of this role is to design and implement a repeatable international platform model, prove it in the first market, and enable each local entity to operate its own identity and local access services within centrally governed technology, security and identity standards.

The role owns the international Azure platform end to end, from design and build through ongoing run. Identity is delivered on a build-and-hand-over basis: the role designs and implements each entity's Entra environment, then transitions day-to-day operation to the local team, remaining involved for enhancement rather than implementation. Both sit within a governance model where technical controls are defined centrally by Allica's UK platform and security functions, and each international entity operates as a consumer of those controls with local attestation.

Accountabilities

Multi-market platform foundations, delivered as code

  • Design and build a parameterised Azure landing zone that can be instantiated per market, covering subscription and management group topology, networking, connectivity, policy assignment, and baseline observability.

  • Deliver the entire estate through Infrastructure as Code with peer review, automated policy compliance checks, and no manual configuration changes. The landing zone is a product, not a project.

  • Make market-specific variation explicit and narrow — a small, documented set of local deltas over a common baseline, rather than a fork.

    Identity and access across multiple entities

  • Work with central Technology, Identity and Security teams to design and implement a repeatable Entra operating model for international entities, including tenant structure, directory topology, privileged-access patterns, joiner–mover– leaver processes and conditional-access baselines.

  • Lead the technical onboarding and initial implementation of each entity’s Entra environment in line with centrally approved architecture and control standards.

  • Ensure each local entity has the capability, documentation, access model, runbooks and evidence processes required to operate its own Entra tenant dayto-day.

  • Establish a clear handover and assurance model: local entity teams operate workforce identity and local access administration; central teams own the architectural standards and control baseline; the International Platform team leads implementation and, following handover, supports oversight and enhancement rather than day-to-day operation.

  • Work with central identity owners on cross-entity access and material design changes. Local regulatory deltas and exceptions must be documented, evidenced and approved through the central governance process.

Regulatory and control assurance

  • Operate the "central controls, local attestation" model: implement Allica's centrally-defined control set in each market, maintain the evidence that demonstrates it, and manage the thin layer of genuine local regulatory delta.

  • Produce and maintain a local-delta attestation template that scales to further markets.

  • Ensure the platform meets DORA and operational resilience obligations — ICT risk management, incident classification and reporting, resilience testing, and third-party ICT arrangements.

Running the platform

  • Own service availability and performance for the international platform, including on-call arrangements, incident management, SLOs, capacity, and change management.

  • Define an operating model that is sustainable for a small team across time zones, and that scales as markets are added rather than multiplying headcount linearly.

  • Feed run experience back into the landing zone templates so each subsequent market starts from a better baseline.

Leading the team

  • Recruit, lead, and develop a small, senior engineering team. Set the technical bar and be an active participant in the work.

Personal Attributes & Experience

  • Substantial hands-on Azure architecture experience at scale, including landing zone design, management group and subscription topology, networking, and Azure Policy

  • .Deep, practical Infrastructure as Code capability (Terraform) including module design for reuse, and CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure.

  • Demonstrable experience designing and operating Microsoft Entra ID in a multientity or multi-tenant context: tenancy models, conditional access, privileged identity management, and identity lifecycle automation.

  • Delivery within a regulated financial services environment, with working knowledge of operational resilience expectations and DORA, and direct experience producing evidence for regulators or auditors.

  • Experience running production platforms, not only building them, incident management, on-call, and service ownership.

  • Track record leading small, senior engineering teams while remaining technically hands-on.

  • Comfort operating within a centrally governed control environment, and the judgement to distinguish a genuine local regulatory requirement from a preference.

  • Work closely with UK platform, security, and product-engineering functions. This role influences the central control set through evidence and horizon scanning, and does not diverge from it unilaterally.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer - EMEA
description:
Redpanda is the first runtime and control plane for agent-data interaction — a unified platform that combines streaming, SQL analytics, and intelligent connectivity with the governance layer enterprise AI agents need in production.

Built on infrastructure already trusted by Fortune 500 companies and fast-growing startups, Redpanda enforces governance entirely outside the agent's data path, controlling what agents see, limiting what they do, and capturing a tamper-proof record of everything they touch, so organizations never have to choose between innovation and control.

About the Role: 

Redpanda is building the Agentic Data Plane (ADP) — the streaming and data infrastructure the world’s largest enterprises run mission-critical agents on. The enterprises winning right now are building agents that encode their own business logic, their own data, their own institutional knowledge into production-grade infrastructure. That’s digital sovereignty, and Redpanda ADP is the infrastructure layer that makes it real.

Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) is the delivery arm. We embed engineers directly with strategic customers and build the agents and integrations that turn ADP into owned outcomes. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you are the builder: embedded on-site, working inside the customer’s environment, writing the code that ships.

This is not a solutions engineering role. You are not here to demo or advise. You are here to build — agents, integrations, data pipelines, and the infrastructure that runs them — alongside a customer team, in their environment, on their timeline.

You Will:  

  • Build at the customer site. Write production-quality agents, integrations, and data pipelines on Redpanda ADP, inside the customer’s environment and codebase. What you ship has to work after you leave. 

  • Work in unfamiliar territory, fast. Every customer engagement is a new codebase, a new data environment, a new set of constraints. Ramp quickly, orient to what exists, build on top of it without breaking it.

  • Own the technical deliverable. Understand what the engagement is supposed to produce, design the technical approach, build it, and hand it off clean — documented, maintainable, and running in production.

  • Be the Redpanda technical voice with the customer’s engineers. Work alongside their team daily. Earn their trust. Make sure the work integrates correctly with what they already have and what they’ll maintain after you leave.

  • Drive toward exit from day one. Build with handoff in mind. Write documentation that their team can actually use. Train them on what you built. Don’t create dependencies on you.

  • Feed learnings back. Identify patterns across engagements — what customers keep needing to build, where ADP makes things hard, what should be productized. Bring that back to Product and Engineering clearly.

You Have: 

  • Engineering depth. You write production software. You’ve built backend systems, data pipelines, APIs, or agent systems that ran in production and had real consequences when they broke. Language background is flexible; what matters is that you build things that work.

  • Agent and integration experience. You’ve built agents, worked with LLM APIs, or built integrations between complex systems. You know what makes an agent reliable vs. brittle, and you’ve made that call in production.

  • Ability to operate in any environment. You’ve worked in someone else’s codebase, with constraints you didn’t set, in a stack you didn’t choose. You can read unfamiliar code, understand what it does, and extend it without breaking it.

  • Customer-facing communication. You can work directly with a customer’s engineering team — their leads, their architects, their individual contributors — and be a credible, trusted technical partner. You don’t need a PM to translate for you.

  • Shipped at a customer site or in a deployment context. You’ve personally been in the room when something hard went live. You know the difference between a demo and a production deployment.

Bonus:

  • Experience in a forward-deployed or customer-embedded engineering model — Anthropic FDE, OpenAI Deployed Engineer, Stripe FDE, Sierra, Palantir FDSE, or analogous.

  • Background in streaming or real-time data systems (Kafka, Flink, Redpanda, or similar).

  • Experience in regulated industries (financial services, healthcare, public sector) or air-gapped environments.

  • Have been the first or only technical person in a customer engagement — run it end-to-end without a playbook.

How We Work:

  • Reports to: Head of FDE 

  • Travel: 30–50% during active engagements; lighter between engagements. You’ll be on-site when the build is live.

description:
About Us

At algo1, we are reinventing one of the world’s most familiar experiences: the in-store grocery trip. We are building an AI-native product that understands each shopper, responds to their context in real time and makes an everyday experience less stressful, more personal and more engaging.

We’re backed by leading investors and founded by two entrepreneurs: one with a track record of building companies, and the other a leader in retail data and shopper analytics. Together, they have brought together frontier AI researchers and engineers, product and strategy leaders, and senior operators from major UK and US grocery businesses.

The people who join now will have an opportunity to shape the product, the engineering culture, and what algo1 becomes.


The Role

This role reports to our Head of Platform, Jack. Working with him and the platform engineering pod, you'll accelerate the development of algo1's platform, turning enterprise-grade platform expectations into software that our product pods and customers rely on.

You'll work primarily in the backend and on the infrastructure that underpins it, but the shopper and retailer experience will never be far from your mind.

Delivering a great platform means product engineers can ship quality, scalable solutions; product, design, and non-technical colleagues can prototype ideas quickly using our application code and production data as a baseline; shoppers have responsive, personalised in-store experiences; and retailers and brands can configure, monitor, and analyse their campaigns across potentially billions of data points.

We're agentic-first. Every engineer has access to frontier AI tooling and our own coding harness, and we expect you to use them to move faster, attempt more ambitious work, and stay fully accountable for what you ship.

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer, though Staff engineers and ambitious early-career engineers with strong platform instincts will also be considered.

What You'll Own

  • Product security. Own authentication across algo1, retailer and brand employees, shoppers, devices, agents, and third-party services, alongside authorisation covering RBAC and ReBAC.

  • Release engineering. Develop and maintain reliable, consistent automated release cycles that get changes to production safely and quickly.

  • Cloud environments. Manage the environments that support prototyping features across our Android and web applications alongside changes to one or more of our backend microservices.

  • API and event-driven architecture. Gatekeep the quality of our APIs, webhooks, and event-driven architecture in an open contributor model.

  • Agentic enablement. Continually improve our internal agentic harnesses (skills, context, and tooling) that allow other engineers and less technical colleagues to develop and prototype on our platform.

  • Agentic automation. Add agentic automation to all appropriate areas of the platform stack without compromising on quality.

 

About You

Must Have

  • Distributed systems experience. You've designed or meaningfully contributed to distributed backend systems, and understand event-driven patterns, asynchronous messaging, and the trade-offs at scale.

  • API design and evolution. You've designed APIs that other teams and clients depend on, and you understand the trade-offs between clean design, backwards compatibility, and speed.

  • Database and schema fluency. Practical experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL or similar), including schema design, indexing, migrations, and query optimisation. Working knowledge of at least one non-relational store.

  • Real-time data. Experience processing or analysing real-time data streams at scale.

  • Cloud infrastructure. Experience deploying and operating distributed services on AWS, GCP, or Azure.

  • Shipping complex, customer-facing products at pace. Evidence that you can move real software into production quickly, making pragmatic decisions without letting perfection become a blocker.

  • Growth and ambition. A career that has moved fast, where you've taken on more scope sooner than the timeline would suggest.

  • AI-native engineering. You've shipped production code with frontier AI tools (Cursor, Claude Code, or similar) and push further into agentic workflows rather than push back on them.

 

Nice to Have (or We Can Teach)

  • Polyglot engineer. Professional software engineering experience across the stack, with your strongest work in the platform, and a portfolio of production systems you've owned end-to-end.

  • B2B or enterprise product experience. Background building for business or enterprise customers, where reliability, integrations, and data pipelines matter as much as the interface.

  • Product mindset. You care about the people using what you build, and you take ownership for what your team puts in front of them, not just the part you wrote.

  • Containers and orchestration. Docker and Kubernetes in production.

  • Retail or personalisation. Familiarity with retail technology, commerce platforms, or customer personalisation systems.

  • Startup experience. Background working at an early-stage startup.

 

How We Work

We're a startup, so this is a high-intensity environment. The people who thrive here are curious, proactive, and love building. If you're happiest when you're creating, experimenting, and moving fast, you'll love it here.

We draw our energy from being together, so this is an office-based role. It suits someone who enjoys the quick conversations and shared momentum that comes from building together. Our office is on what we think is the best garden square in London, just a couple of minutes from Tottenham Court Road, so it's easy to get to and a great place to build.

What We Offer

  • Direct access to our founders and a real voice in the calls that shape the product and the company.

  • Competitive salary and meaningful equity.

  • 25 days' annual leave plus bank holidays.

  • Team offsites.

  • Cycle to work scheme

title: Customer Operations Associate, Transfers
description:
About Freetrade

Freetrade’s mission is to become the default place to invest. Investing has been too complicated and expensive for too long, keeping millions from making the most of their savings.

We’re changing that.

We’re building our team and looking for people who are excited to reshape how our customers invest and grow their wealth. If you’re driven by solving complex problems and building innovative products, you’ll fit right in.

2026 is a big year for us. Last year, we announced a game changing deal to become part of the IG Group. We’ll continue to operate as an independent business while gaining access to the resources and support of an established leader in the space.

This year, we’re accelerating our roadmap and taking our products to the next level. We’re building new features like mutual funds, bonds, and family investment tools. We’re also exploring how we can leverage AI to deliver an even better experience for our customers.

A quick heads-up before you dive in: Applications will close on Wednesday, 26th August, end of day, so if you're keen, don't leave it too late! After the deadline, our team will go through every application and pick who we'd love to bring forward.

We will be running an assessment day at our London office on the 10th of September — so please only apply if you're free to join us in person that day. We can't wait to meet you!

About the Role

As a Customer Operations Associate, you’ll join our Transfers team within Operations, where your initial focus will be on building deep expertise in transfers and delivering great outcomes for our customers.

You’ll help customers move their investment accounts and assets into and out of Freetrade, owning cases from start to finish and working with customers, external counterparties and teams across the business to make sure transfers are completed accurately, efficiently and within the required timelines.

This is detailed, deadline-driven work where accuracy, ownership and follow-through really matter. You’ll develop a strong understanding of the rules and regulations governing ISA transfers, alongside the operational processes involved in cash and stock transfers, valuations, asset acceptance and CREST. You will also build experience across areas such as JISAs, fund transfers and European stock transfers.

At the centre of the role is genuine care about getting the customer the right outcome. We’re looking for people who take ownership, care deeply about the experience customers have and are willing to follow a problem through until it’s resolved.

Your initial focus will be Transfers, but our longer-term ambition is to build a more cross-trained and flexible Operations team. As you develop, there may be opportunities to gain exposure to other areas such as Payments, Corporate Actions, Trading & Settlements, Customer Service and Complaints, helping you build a broader understanding of how Operations works and how different workflows connect.

This isn’t a rotation programme, and there’s no set timeline or expectation that you’ll move between teams. Opportunities to broaden your knowledge will depend on your development, team priorities and the needs of the business.

Our aim is to develop operators with both depth and breadth across Operations - people who understand their own area deeply, can connect the dots across different workflows and use that knowledge to get better outcomes for customers.

AI and automation are a real part of how Operations is evolving at Freetrade. We’re looking for people who are genuinely enthusiastic about using technology to continuously improve their work - actively finding ways to work faster and smarter and contributing to automation and efficiency improvements as they go.

What You'll Do

  • Own transfer cases from start to finish, helping customers move ISA, JISA, GIA and SIPP accounts and assets into and out of Freetrade, with a focus on accuracy and a smooth customer outcome

  • Process transfer applications accurately and within agreed SLAs.

  • Process valuations and provide acceptance of assets within agreed SLAs.

  • Chase and monitor transfer progress with external counterparties and customers, taking ownership of cases through to completion.

  • Build a strong working knowledge of ISA and SIPP transfer rules, regulations and operational requirements.

  • Work with CREST processes and develop your understanding of stock and asset transfers.

  • Provide technical support to our Customer Service team, helping them answer customer queries accurately and efficiently.

  • Communicate clearly with customers through email and in-app chat and, as our support channels evolve, potentially phone.

  • Keep clear, accurate records of the cases you handle to support quality, compliance and audit standards.

  • Spot patterns in the cases and queries you handle, identifying process gaps and opportunities to improve the customer experience.

  • Review procedures and contribute to process enhancements, challenging inefficient ways of working and helping make things better.

  • Use AI tools as a core part of your day-to-day workflow, actively looking for practical ways to improve your productivity, quality and the efficiency of the wider team.

  • Support the wider Transfers team with ad-hoc tasks and changing priorities when needed.

  • Work closely with your workflow lead to align on priorities and flag anything getting in the way of good customer outcomes.

  • Support newer joiners as your own knowledge and experience grow.

  • Champion a customer-first mindset in everything you do, treating every case with the same level of care you would expect if it were your own account.

About you

  • A genuinely customer-obsessed mindset, with a strong desire to deliver the right outcome and a great experience for every customer

  • Exceptional attention to detail, recognising that the processes you’ll work on are critical to the business and can have regulatory and customer implications if not completed accurately

  • The ability to work independently and proactively, taking ownership of your workload and following cases through to completion

  • A self-starter mindset, with the confidence to identify problems, take initiative and drive changes or improvements without needing significant direction or support

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly with customers, colleagues and external counterparties

  • A continuous improvement mindset, with experience or an interest in reviewing procedures, identifying gaps and making practical process enhancements

  • Strong judgement and ownership, with the confidence to make good decisions while knowing when something needs to be escalated

  • Experience with, or knowledge of, CREST transfers would be beneficial, alongside knowledge of ISA transfers, JISAs, fund transfers or European stock transfers

  • Genuine enthusiasm for using AI as part of your day-to-day work, with curiosity about how it can improve processes, quality and operational efficiency

  • Curiosity and learning agility, with an appetite to build deep expertise in Transfers while developing a broader understanding of Operations over time

Our hybrid model

We work from our central London and Budapest offices on Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday, leaving Wednesday and Friday for dedicated focus time at home.

We believe in the power of in-person collaboration to build a strong culture, but we know "life happens." If you have caregiving or personal responsibilities that require extra flexibility, let’s talk about it.

Interview Process

We keep things simple and transparent:

  • Initial interview – A chat with our Talent Partner

  • Short Take Home Task - To ensure you're set up for success in the role

  • Assessment day at our London office:

    • Hiring Manager Interview – A deep dive into your skills and experience

    • Values Interview – Values alignment interview with one of our Senior Leadership team

We are an Equal Opportunity employer committed to a diverse and representative team. Whatever your race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability - we want to hear from you.

To find out more about how we look after your personal data when you apply for a job with us, please see our Recruitment Privacy Policy here.

Please note we are not accepting agency CVs.

Compensation: £28K – £35K

title: Applied AI Engineer
description:
About the Team

OpenAI’s Applied AI Engineering team helps organizations turn frontier AI capabilities into safe, reliable, and high-impact production systems. We work with customer executives, product and engineering teams, security leaders, and transformation teams to identify valuable opportunities, accelerate technical implementation, and scale what works.

Enterprise deployments are defined by complexity rather than any one industry: existing architectures, diverse data environments, security and governance requirements, multiple stakeholder groups, and organization-wide change. We turn lessons from these deployments into better products and reusable patterns for customers everywhere.

About the Role

As an Applied AI Engineer you will partner directly with leading organizations to design, build, and deploy AI systems that deliver measurable business outcomes. You will combine deep technical judgment, hands-on engineering, and customer leadership to take ambitious ideas from use-case selection and architecture through prototyping, evaluation, production launch, and scale.

You will write and debug code, build evaluation systems, resolve complex integrations, and guide decisions involving model behavior, reliability, latency, cost, safety, security, governance, and operational readiness. Success is measured by production systems, sustained adoption, and meaningful customer impact—not simply activity or successful demonstrations.

This is a rare opportunity to work on consequential real-world deployments at the frontier of AI while directly influencing how OpenAI’s products evolve.

This role is based in London. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees

In this role, you will:

  • Partner directly with enterprise customers to identify high-value opportunities and translate them into technical architectures, implementation plans, evaluation strategies, and measurable success criteria.

  • Design, build, and deploy AI systems that solve important customer problems and produce measurable business outcomes.

  • Work hands-on in code to build prototypes, evaluation harnesses, reference implementations, integrations, and production accelerators.

  • Make sound technical decisions across models, agents, retrieval, tools, data, reliability, observability, latency, cost, safety, security, and governance.

  • Diagnose complex implementation challenges, reproduce failures, test hypotheses, and drive blockers toward resolution.

  • Help customers progress from promising prototypes to reliable production systems, sustained adoption, and scaled impact.

  • Partner closely with customer engineering teams and OpenAI Product, Research, Engineering, Security, and go-to-market teams, translating deployment experience into high-signal product feedback.

  • Create reusable architectures, tooling, playbooks, and technical guidance that accelerate future enterprise deployments.

You’ll thrive in this role if you:

  • Have a demonstrated track record of designing, building, and delivering AI or machine-learning systems in enterprise environments, including taking systems from prototype to production. Relevant backgrounds may include applied AI or ML engineering, forward-deployed engineering, software engineering, customer engineering, solutions architecture, or technical consulting.

  • Can point to substantial personal contributions in code, architecture, evaluation, debugging, or production engineering—not only program or stakeholder management.

  • Are highly proficient in Python and comfortable working across an AI application stack; experience with JavaScript, TypeScript, or another relevant language is valuable.

  • Understand how to evaluate AI systems systematically using representative data, graders, production signals, and human judgment.

  • Have navigated enterprise production requirements such as integrations, reliability, observability, security, privacy, data governance, performance, and cost.

  • Can connect technical decisions to customer workflows, adoption, and measurable business outcomes.

  • Communicate with clarity and credibility across hands-on engineers, technical leaders, security teams, product leaders, and executives.

  • Bring high agency, strong technical judgment, and end-to-end ownership in ambiguous environments.

  • Learn quickly, challenge assumptions constructively, and collaborate with humility; experience in a particular industry or with OpenAI products is not required.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. 

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement.

Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. For unincorporated Los Angeles County workers: we reasonably believe that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment: protect computer hardware entrusted to you from theft, loss or damage; return all computer hardware in your possession (including the data contained therein) upon termination of employment or end of assignment; and maintain the confidentiality of proprietary, confidential, and non-public information. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations.

To notify OpenAI that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this link.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Applied AI
description:
At CoMind, we are developing a non-invasive neuromonitoring technology that will result in a new era of clinical brain monitoring. In joining us, you will be helping to create cutting-edge technologies that will improve how we diagnose and treat brain disorders, ultimately improving and saving the lives of patients across the world.

The Role:

You will build the platform that transforms raw neuro-signals into longitudinal patient insights, effectively defining the new standard of care in neuro-critical settings.

As a Senior Software Engineer within the CoVision project, you will play a central role in developing, maintaining, and optimising the Large Language Model software deriving actionable intelligence in our fleet of neuromonitoring products. You will bridge the gap between advanced AI research and production-ready, regulated medical software, ensuring software reliability across our deployed fleet.

At CoMind, all team members work at least 4 days per week from our new Kings Cross offices, plus a flexible work-from-home day.

Responsibilities:

  • AI Integration: Integrate an on-device LLM into the CoMind One system, connecting it to live neuromonitoring signals and building the query and response layer clinicians interact with.

  • Model Evaluation & Reliability: Own how we measure whether the model answers the right clinical questions correctly and consistently. Build the evaluation, prompting and guard-rail approaches that keep output safe to show at the bedside.

  • Systems Performance: Optimise inference performance on constrained on-device hardware, managing latency, memory and throughput within the CoMind One system.

  • Medical Device Software Development: Design and develop medical device software to IEC 62304 and ISO 14971, from real-time on-device behaviour through to the interfaces clinicians touch.

  • Compliance & Cybersecurity: Ensure AI deployments meet cybersecurity requirements and regulatory standards, including FDA guidance for AI/ML-enabled devices.

  • Reliability & Collaboration: Keep the deployed fleet reliable, and work directly with hardware, product and clinical teams to diagnose and resolve issues quickly.

  • AI is fundamental to our culture — it's not just a tool, but a core part of how we work, collaborate, and innovate. We expect all team members to embrace AI in their daily work and continuously find new ways to use it effectively.

Skills & Experience:

  • 7+ years of hands-on software engineering.

  • Comfortable working in C++, with Python alongside it.

  • Practical experience using LLMs as an applied tool: prompting, guardrails, RAG, evaluation, and reasoning about model behaviour.

  • You've built, or extended a model and integrated it meaningfully into a real product, close to the surface users actually touch.

  • Experience integrating third-party libraries or complex components into a larger system, ideally performance-sensitive or resource-constrained.

  • Comfortable reasoning about performance: latency, memory and throughput on constrained hardware.

  • Strong with Git and CI/CD.

Nice to have

  • Edge / on-device AI: running models on constrained hardware such as Jetson, Android, iPad, Raspberry Pi or microcontrollers.

  • Hands-on with llama.cpp or similar, and evaluating small on-device models (e.g. Qwen, Gemma, MedGemma, custom).

  • Some hardware exposure: anyone doing genuine edge AI tends to have this.

  • Cloud experience (AWS), particularly running LLMs in a cloud environment.

  • A background in a regulated or safety-critical industry

Benefits:

  • Company equity plan so all employees share in the success of the company

  • Salary-sacrifice pension scheme

  • Private medical, dental and vision insurance (medical history disregarded)

  • Group life assurance at 4x annual income

  • Comprehensive mental health support, including unlimited access to 1:1 sessions with trained professionals

  • Unlimited holiday allowance (+ bank holidays) and one week of remote working per quarter

  • Lunch voucher (£10) every day for JustEat and free dinner on those days where you need to work later

  • Twice weekly deliveries of fresh fruit and an extensive selection of snacks and drinks

  • YuLife subscription, allowing you to turn your daily steps and meditation into discounts at a range of stores

Bazaarvoice is looking for an experienced Engineering Manager to join us in building the future of product discovery.
 
This is a great opportunity to lead a team that's building software used by millions of consumers worldwide.
 
The Engineering Manager will play a significant role as part of a wider leadership team. You will drive team performance through product delivery to meet business needs. You will develop effective teams of skilled professionals, providing direction and coaching on agile working practices. You will build strong relationships with peers and stakeholders across the business. You will provide technical oversight and direction, regularly interfacing with other teams across the organisation.
 
You’ll also be an integral member of the product development team, working closely with your product management and product design colleagues to develop new features and client experiences.
 
 

About You:
  • You’re a passionate technologist with 6+ years of Software Engineering experience and 3+ years as a People Manager/Lead.
  • You’re an excellent leader, communicator, innovative and self-motivated, with a positive approach to teamwork- Working to shape and encourage those who have the skills to build software solutions within a Product Development practice.
  • You have experience working in an agile software development environment and will seek out opportunities for improvement whilst identifying and managing risk.
  • You have an analytical approach and have experience in evaluating capability needs and the suitability of initiatives against the strategy.
  • You are exceptionally well organised and drive a high standard of output for yourself and your team.
  • You’ll have the ability to challenge effectively and constructively, whilst driving good practice, both personally and with your colleagues, ensuring clear, well-informed and focused presentation of output to key stakeholders and clients at varying levels.
  • You’re comfortable balancing speed-to-market and long-term engineering decisions.
  • You have a passion for people management, mentorship, and career growth on your team.
  • You’re data-driven in your decision-making, willing to take calculated risks and fail fast, and aren’t afraid to raise your hand when you see areas to improve.
  • You have practical experience with AI development and delivery, taking a proactive and innovative approach to driving modern AI capabilities into real-world software solutions.
  • You have a knack for driving engineering efforts and communicating with cross-functional teams and key stakeholders.

    • Responsibilities:
  • Providing coaching, mentorship, and career development.
  • Optimising team velocity by ruthlessly prioritising workload, removing roadblocks to progress, and actively protecting the team from disturbance, disruption, or outside interference.
  • Closely collaborating on product strategy with your Product Manager, and working with him/her to manage and prioritise the product backlog.
  • Identifying opportunities for your team’s professional development and work with the right partners to make it happen.
  • Anticipating future people requirements and working with the talent team to recruit, evaluate, and hire great new team members.
  • Providing performance feedback and complete performance evaluations for the team.
  • Providing informal performance feedback on a frequent basis, recognising achievement and flagging opportunities for growth.
  • Providing advice and assistance to teams on technical difficulties that arise in the course of doing their work..
  • Leveraging your experience to flag issues that your team might overlook (such as scalability, performance, security, compliance, operational readiness, etc.).
  • Staying current in the development tools and technologies that your team members are using.

title: Director of Operational Planning & Value Realisation
description:
Who we are:

We're one of Europe's fastest-growing fintech companies – on a mission to create the world's most empowering way to pay.

We launched the product in 2020 and achieved double unicorn status, valued at $2 billion, and since then have taken on more than 6 million customers.

 

Our mission is to become the best way to pay for anything, anywhere and say goodbye to credit costs for everyone. This is huge. Want to join us?

About the role.

The Director of Operational Planning & Value Realisation is responsible for the commercial stewardship of Service Operations.

The role provides executive ownership for the planning, analytical and commercial disciplines that ensure operational investment, AI adoption, workforce strategy and transformation activity translate into measurable improvements in customer outcomes, operational efficiency and financial performance.

Working alongside Operational Excellence, the Director ensures Service Operations not only creates value through continuous improvement, but consistently realises that value through disciplined planning, commercial governance and operational optimisation.

Primary Accountabilities

The Director is accountable for ensuring Service Operations continues to improve its economic contribution to the wider business.

This includes executive ownership for:

  • Operational planning

  • Workforce strategy

  • Supplier strategy

  • Business Analysis

  • Commercial modelling

  • Operational investment appraisal

  • Benefits realisation

  • Cost-to-serve optimisation

  • Productivity improvement

  • Efficient growth

  • Commercial governance of operational transformation

The role ensures Service Operations remains commercially efficient as customer volumes, AI capability and product complexity continue to grow.

Day to day responsibilities.

Commercial Stewardship

  • Provide executive ownership for the commercial performance of Service Operations.

  • Ensure operational investment decisions maximise customer outcomes alongside financial performance.

  • Develop robust commercial frameworks supporting operational decision making.

  • Partner with Finance to improve visibility of operational economics.

  • Ensure Service Operations contributes positively to broader business performance.

Operational Planning

Lead long-term operational planning. Develop strategies covering:

  • Workforce capacity

  • AI adoption

  • Outsourcing

  • International expansion

  • Operational resilience

  • Resource allocation

Ensure Service Operations remains scalable as the business grows.

Business Analysis & Value Realisation

Lead the Business Analysis function.

Develop robust business cases supporting operational investment.

Establish consistent approaches to:

  • opportunity sizing

  • commercial modelling

  • investment appraisal

  • benefits realisation

Ensure every significant operational initiative has clearly defined success measures and measurable financial outcomes.

Track realised benefits and challenge initiatives that fail to deliver expected value.

Workforce Strategy

Lead Workforce Management.

Develop long-term workforce strategies that balance:

  • customer demand

  • AI capability

  • automation

  • internal capability

  • outsourced delivery

  • operational resilience

Ensure workforce planning evolves beyond forecasting into strategic operational capacity planning.

Supplier Strategy

Lead Supplier Management.

Develop long-term sourcing strategies that balance:

  • customer outcomes

  • operational resilience

  • commercial performance

  • scalability

Ensure supplier strategy evolves alongside increasing automation and international growth.

Lead executive supplier governance.

Executive Decision Support

Provide analytical support for executive operational decision making.

Develop executive dashboards covering:

  • cost-to-serve

  • productivity

  • operational investment

  • benefits realisation

  • workforce strategy

  • supplier performance

Support prioritisation of operational investment.

Provide evidence-based recommendations to the Operations Leadership Team.

Leadership Responsibilities

Lead the teams responsible for:

  • Workforce Management

  • Business Analysis

  • Supplier Management

Develop a culture of commercial thinking.

Embed disciplined planning and evidence-based decision making.

Build organisational capability in commercial modelling, investment appraisal and benefits realisation.

Coach leaders to understand the economic impact of operational decisions.

Success Measures

The Director will be accountable for improvements in:

Commercial

  • Cost-to-serve

  • Productivity

  • Return on operational investment

  • Benefits realisation

  • Financial contribution of Service Operations

  • Operational efficiency
